updates.text: Andre Branch beat Johnson around the corner, but left the lane on a July 30 team rep. After Crennel's correction he kept contain and still produced pressure August 1. The isolated win and assignment error both matter; Edge 1 remains open.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Andre Branch was a rotation defensive end for Jacksonville in 2013, dressing for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games, and competed with Jeremy Mincey for the first edge spot in 2014 camp. He brings a useful first step and pursuit, and in that camp he beat Lane Johnson around the corner. He still needs a more developed hand and counter plan and firmer edge play to become a dependable full-time starter; in camp he twice left his lane while winning a rush, then kept contain on every recorded practice rep after Romeo Crennel's second correction.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
